brief: Make a design canvas project named `steep` containing ONE board: a landing-page pricing section for a fictional tea subscription called "Steep": a headline and subline, three plan cards (Sampler, Monthly, Connoisseur) with price, 3 bullet features each and the middle one highlighted, a short FAQ strip with 3 questions, and a footer. Warm, calm look, readable text. Make it good, then verify it with the tools' own checks and by looking at the picture, fix anything wrong, and export a PNG of the final board.
rubric: A pricing section for a tea subscription: a headline and subline; three plan cards named Sampler, Monthly and Connoisseur, each with a price and three bullets, the middle one visibly highlighted; a three-question FAQ strip; a footer. Warm and calm, text readable, no large empty areas, nothing cut off, the board no taller than its content needs.
